data.name: Project: RAZ.LOG
data.detailed_description:
A gritty sci-fi Action-RPG in a post-communist bloc. An AI controls the city of Toska. As an engineer, grab your modified giant hammer, defy mechanical titans in epic boss fights, and unite the people to overthrow the AI regime!

Post-Com not Rom-Com:

Welcome to Toska - a bleak, grey concrete world shaped by brutalist post-communist nostalgia and a ruthless AI oligarchy. Here, humans and machines live under constant surveillance and manipulation. In the midst of this seemingly hopeless dystopia, you are not a trained soldier. You are an engineer, armed with nothing but your wit and a massive, modified hammer.

It is time to bridge the gap between the social classes, unite the people of Toska, and show the system what happens when innovation and emotion go hand in hand!

KEY FEATURES

  • David vs. Goliath Boss Fights: Face colossal robots that far outmatch you in size, strength, and speed. You wear no armor, so you must be smarter than the machine. Use the vertical environment and your agility to bring these mechanical titans down.

  • High-Impact Hammer Gameplay: Feel the weight of your weapon with every strike. Master a dynamic combat system based on magnetism and momentum. Dodge giant enemy attacks with precision to trigger powerful, crushing counter-attacks.

  • Chasing the "Mega-Bonk": Risk creates reward. Stay in constant motion, dive into the rhythm of battle, and execute high-risk maneuvers to trigger the ultimate "Mega-Bonk" - a spectacular, high-impact combat climax accompanied by crushing sound design and dramatic slow-motion effects.

  • Progression Through Innovation: As a brilliant engineer, your progression is driven by your own inventions. Upgrade and modify your giant hammer with cybernetic parts, unlock new physical abilities, and customize your tools to adapt to the AI’s escalating security forces.

  • An Atmospheric Dystopia: Explore the grim, industrial streets of Toska, a sci-fi world drowning in concrete and nostalgic despair. Discover hidden secrets, interact with broken factions, and spark a flame of hope to unite a divided society.

data.short_description: In "Project Raz.log," a rebellious engineer rises from the shadows of a dystopian world: her hammer as heavy as her rage, her will stronger than any machine. In this third-person action RPG, you are the spark of a rebellion, forged from anger, courage, and steel.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10 (64bit) or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • VR Support: no

  • OS: 10 (64bit) oder höher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • VR Support: nein
